envelope.canonical_digest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes

primitive_types.canonical_rule: range -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807; no plus sign or leading zero
range 0 through 18446744073709551615; no plus sign or leading zero
finite base-10 coefficient and scale; exponent notation and negative zero forbidden
finite IEEE-754 binary64 only; NaN, infinity, and negative zero forbidden
valid UTF-8 scalar values normalized to NFC; unpaired surrogates forbidden
RFC 4648 standard alphabet with required padding and no whitespace
UTC Z suffix, fixed microsecond precision, leap-second input rejected
range -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807; no plus sign, leading zero, unit suffix, or floating representation

composite_types.wire: ordered array of typed value envelopes
composite_types.identity_rule: position is significant and duplicate values are permitted

composite_types.wire: array of key and typed-value entries
composite_types.identity_rule: keys are bounded NFC strings, unique by ordinal UTF-8 bytes, and serialized in ordinal order

serialization.round_trip_rule: decode then encode yields the same canonical bytes and digest

persistence.revision_rule: positive monotonically increasing integer scoped to the owning object
persistence.write_rule: validate limits and canonical bytes before any durable mutation
persistence.read_rule: verify stored digest before decoding and never return a partially decoded value
persistence.restart_rule: only a fully committed revision is visible after restart

socket, URL, network, GCS, mission-network, or spacecraft references
unbounded recursion, allocation, strings, bytes, lists, or maps
